experiment.name: Shared data layer: datasets, dogs, variables and coverage of the tidy files (SV-G1)
experiment.description: What do the tidy features and outcomes files of the severity programme hold, and how complete are they? A descriptive record with no hypothesis: counts, variable coverage, missingness, checks and cleaning flags.

sections.heading: Question
paragraphs: What does the shared data layer hold: which datasets, how many dogs, which variables, how complete, and which cleaning decisions and flags a later package must know? SV-G1 runs no statistical test; it records counts, coverage and checks.

sections.heading: What was done
paragraphs: Each raw file was read with a script of its own (Python 3.12, standard library) and written as a features file and an outcomes file in the contract of rules.md. Severity labels and label proxies are only in the outcomes files; dog IDs are neutral (a salted hash order). Units were converted to one unit per harmonised name; 538 rows in shared/dictionary.csv record every column and conversion.

Each dataset was checked against its row counts in data.md and against published summary numbers from its article note or the authors' own summary rows. Values were never corrected silently: suspect values are kept and flagged.

sections.heading: Result
paragraphs: 9 datasets tidied from 8 independent sources: 694 dog records (574 after the known same-dog links), 803 feature records, 538 dictionary rows. Data checks: 141, passed 133.

Per dataset: S-CB050 161 dogs, 15 variables, 14.7% cells missing, checks 21/22; S-CB517 112 dogs, 14 variables, 0.0% cells missing, checks 20/21; DS07 52 dogs, 226 variables, 30.8% cells missing, checks 11/12; S-CB017 47 dogs, 26 variables, 3.0% cells missing, checks 14/14; S-CB516 15 dogs, 17 variables, 0.8% cells missing, checks 18/18; DS05 150 dogs, 42 variables, 1.4% cells missing, checks 12/12; DS03 138 dogs, 17 variables, 7.3% cells missing, checks 7/7; DS02 5 dogs, 50 variables, 15.2% cells missing, checks 5/5; DS04 14 dogs, 131 variables, 45.1% cells missing, checks 25/30.

Failed checks: S-CB050: male:female, survivors (observed [83, 43], expected [82, 43]); S-CB517: median WBC, infected (observed 6.29, expected 6.2); DS07: master proteins with a gene symbol (observed 172, expected 163); DS04: median weight, fatal cases (kg; 8 with a weight) (observed 32.3, expected 34); DS04: mean age, fatal cases (months) (observed 55.0, expected 52.8); DS04: median age, fatal cases (months) (observed 42.0, expected 50); DS04: S-CB147 Table_2 per-case IHC values equal the per-dog field means (rounded to 0.1): mismatches (observed ['case 106 cd3 pt: S-CB147 14.5, mean of fields here 9.67', 'case 20 iba1 cl: S-CB147 7.3, mean of fields here 11.0'], expected []); DS04: IHC per-dog means vs authors' Sheet1 averages: mismatches (observed ['case 20 CV Iba-1: fields [11.0, 11.0, None], Sheet1 7.33', 'case 106 PT CD3: fields [7.0, 7.0, 15.0], Sheet1 14.5'], expected []).
39 values are flagged as probable entry errors or contradictions and kept as reported.

Same-dog links: S-CB517 with S-CB050: Same dogs: S-CB050 cases 1-97 and controls 201-215; DS03 with DS02: The 5 DS03 experimental dogs are the 5 DS02 Beagles (matched by value in SV-G1); DS04 with S-CB050: At least 3 fatal DS04 dogs are S-CB050 cases 126, 127 and 131 (matched by value); DS03 with S-CB050: Possible, unverified (same hospital); DS07 with DS04: Possible, not confirmed (case numbers overlap; no shared values).

sections.heading: What this does not show
paragraphs: Coverage is the share of dogs with at least one value; it says nothing about quality or comparability across files. Raw cytokine values from different files are different assay runs and must not be pooled. Species is aliased with source. No association with severity was computed here.
